name: Lugaidh mac Conn

attributes.attribute: foster son and later enemy of Ailill Olom
defeated Ailill's army at Mag Murmhain
died when Ailill breathed poison on him

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Lugaidh mac Conn was an Irish hero and the foster son of Ailill Olom, the ruler of Munster. He later turned against the king and took on his forces. At the battle of Mag Murmhain Lugaidh defeated Ailill's army. Afterward he sought to make peace with the king, but Ailill breathed his poisoned breath upon Lugaidh while he still lived, and so the hero died.

okr.objective: Document Lugaidh mac Conn and his quarrel with Ailill Olom.
